title: Recorded run (reference) — NOT a fixed expected output
reproduction_note: AlphaFold3 / AF2 / Chai-1 / Boltz-2 are non-deterministic across model version, hardware (GPU/CPU, CUDA), MSA depth and seed. A re-fold will NOT reproduce these numbers exactly. Compare the confidence REGIME (this 52-aa target folds at LOW global confidence: pTM well below 0.5, an N-terminal signal-peptide-like disordered stretch), not exact values. The input_fasta_sha256 anchors the INPUT; the structure outputs are stochastic.
external_vs_internal: pLDDT / PAE / pTM are EXTERNAL metrics (AlphaFold, DeepMind/EBI definitions) and are the independently checkable layer. SR9 / DI2 / final_drift are Flamehaven ADVISORY signals and are not part of this external structural check.
